rows.ja: 電力の販売先(データセンター)

relations.text: 再稼働するスリーマイル島(Crane Clean Energy Center)の出力をMicrosoftが20年間購入する契約
relations.text_en: 20-year PPA under which Microsoft buys the output of the restarted Crane Clean Energy Center

source.label: Constellation 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In September 2024, we executed a 20-year PPA with Microsoft that will support the restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1, renamed as the Crane Clean Energy Center
source.note: 再稼働と供給開始は、規制当局の承認が前提です。
source.note_en: Restart and deliveries are subject to regulatory approvals.

relations.text: イリノイ州Clinton発電所の出力1,121MWを20年間供給する契約
relations.text_en: 20-year PPA for 1,121MW of output from the Clinton Clean Energy Center in Illinois

source.label: Constellation の発表(2025年6月3日)
source.quote: Constellation (Nasdaq: CEG) and Meta have signed a 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) for the output of the Clinton Clean Energy Center

relations.text: NRGが持つSouth Texas Project原子力発電所の44%持分を約16.5億ドルで取得
relations.text_en: Constellation acquired NRG’s 44% interest in the South Texas Project nuclear plant for about $1.65B

source.label: NRG Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 1, 2023, the Company closed on the sale of its 44 % equity interest in STP to Constellation Energy Generation

relations.text: SalemとPeach Bottomの原子力発電所を共同保有
relations.text_en: Co-owns the Salem and Peach Bottom nuclear stations with Constellation

source.label: PSEG 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: PSEG Power co-owns Salem and Peach Bottom with Constellation Energy Generation, LLC. PSEG Power is the operator of Salem and Constellation Energy Generation, LLC is the operator of Peach Bottom.

relations.text: 2022年2月にExelonから分離独立。移行サービス契約でつながりが残る
relations.text_en: Spun off from Exelon in February 2022; the two remain linked by a transition services agreement

source.label: Constellation 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 1, 2022, Exelon completed the separation by distributing all the outstanding shares of the Company's common stock
source.note: 分離は過去の出来事です。

relations.text: メイン州Wyman石油火力発電所の少数持分を保有。主な所有者NextEra Energy Resourcesが運営
relations.text_en: Constellation holds a minority stake in the Wyman (Maine) oil-fired plant, operated by principal owner NextEra Energy Resources

source.label: Constellation 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: except for Wyman, which is operated by the principal owner, NextEra Energy Resources LLC, a subsidiary of NextEra Energy, Inc.
source.note: 小規模な石油・ガス資産で、この文では持分割合は書かれていません。
source.note_en: A small oil/gas asset; this sentence does not state the ownership percentage.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
